sourcing: Every price, SKU, option list and image below was pulled from the brand's own public Shopify feed on 2026-09-26. Products the user listed that could not be verified (blocked sites, or names that do not exist as listed) were replaced with a same-type product from a brand feed that answers, and each replacement is named in the notes.

products.name: TropiClean Coconut Hypoallergenic Puppy & Kitten Shampoo
products.description: A tearless coconut shampoo from TropiClean made for puppies and kittens. The 20 fl oz bottle is the store's standard size, and the mild formula is intended for young animals and routine bathing.
products.image_alt: TropiClean coconut hypoallergenic puppy and kitten shampoo 20 oz bottle
products.notes: Chosen variant 'Default Title', USD 14.99, store SKU TRGNSH20Z-LN. Kept as the user's TropiClean Gentle Coconut Puppy Shampoo.

products.name: EarthBath Oatmeal & Aloe Itch Relief Shampoo
products.description: EarthBath's vanilla and almond oat and aloe shampoo in the 128 fl oz size. Oatmeal and aloe sit at the base of the brand's itch relief line, and the large bottle suits regular grooming use.
products.image_alt: EarthBath Oatmeal and Aloe itch relief shampoo large 128 oz bottle
products.notes: Chosen variant '128 fl oz', USD 81.99, store SKU PA4G. Store options: 128 fl oz; 320 fl oz. Full store price range 81.99-148.99. Kept as the user's Earthbath Oatmeal & Aloe Shampoo; the 4 oz size is no longer listed, so the 128 fl oz variant is used. The published pack shot is over 4 MB, so the localizer stores the same photo at width=1200.

products.name: Oneisall N12 4-in-1 Dog Grooming Kit
products.description: A four-in-one dog grooming kit from Oneisall that combines clipping and finishing steps in one set. It is sold as a complete kit for owners doing routine trimming at home.
products.image_alt: Oneisall N12 4-in-1 dog grooming kit with clipper and attachments
products.notes: Chosen variant 'Blue / Standard', USD 29.99, store SKU CW03050. Store options: Blue; Standard. Substitute for Wahl Pet Clipper Kit; wahl.com is Magento with no readable feed and no product sitemap from this host.

products.name: Neakasa Steel Pet Nail Clipper
products.description: A steel pet nail clipper from Neakasa, sold as a single hand tool. It is a straightforward manual trimmer for keeping a dog's or cat's nails short between grooming visits.
products.image_alt: Neakasa steel pet nail clipper product photo
products.notes: Chosen variant 'Default Title', USD 19.99, store SKU nail-clipper. Substitute for Safari Professional Nail Trimmer; safaripet.com fails the TLS handshake from this host.

products.name: tuft + paw THE BATH BRUSH Silicone Grooming Brush
products.description: A dual-use silicone grooming brush from tuft + paw's Pride + Groom line, listed for de-shedding, massaging and wet use. One tool covers bathing and coat care, wet or dry.
products.image_alt: tuft + paw Pride and Groom silicone bath brush for dogs and cats
products.notes: Chosen variant 'Default Title', USD 22.00, store SKU PG-BRUSH-SILICONE-SET. Substitute for Hertzko Self-Cleaning Slicker Brush; hertzko.com fails TLS from this host.

products.name: Oneisall LM5 4-in-1 Pet Grooming Vacuum Kit
products.size: LM2 full kit or LM5 lite kit
products.description: A grooming vacuum kit from Oneisall that lifts loose hair while the animal is being groomed, in either the LM2 full kit or the LM5 lite kit. It suits heavy-shedding dogs where loose coat collects around the home.
products.image_alt: Oneisall LM5 4-in-1 pet grooming vacuum kit with clipper and vacuum
products.notes: Chosen variant 'LM2-Full Grooming Kit', USD 79.99, store SKU CW16001. Store options: LM5-Lite Grooming Kit; LM2-Full Grooming Kit. Substitute for Furminator Undercoat Deshedding Tool; furminator.com fails certificate verification from this host.

products.name: Oneisall RK034 Clipper Guide Combs 5-Pack
products.description: A five pack of RK034 guide combs for Oneisall pet clippers, used to set coat length while clipping. They are the standard length attachments that pair with Oneisall's RK034 clipper body.
products.image_alt: Oneisall RK034 clipper guide combs 5 pack set
products.notes: Chosen variant 'Default Title', USD 13.99, store SKU PJ05039. Substitute for Andis Premium Pet Grooming Comb; andis.com publishes only category URLs and no per-product feed.

products.name: EarthBath Oatmeal & Aloe Grooming Wipes
products.description: A hundred count pack of EarthBath's oat and aloe grooming wipes, for cleaning paws, coats and faces between full baths. The wipes carry the same oat and aloe base as the brand's shampoo line.
products.image_alt: EarthBath Oatmeal and Aloe grooming wipes 100 count pack
products.notes: Chosen variant '100 ct', USD 18.99, store SKU PA7WS. Store options: 100 ct. Type change: fills the KONG ZoomGroom brush slot with wipes, because no comparable brush could be verified (kongcompany.com exposes no per-product feed). Every other row in this batch is a same-type swap.

products.name: tuft + paw THE MANE TAME Waterless Dog & Cat Shampoo
products.description: A waterless no-rinse shampoo for dogs and cats from tuft + paw's Pride + Groom line. It is meant for quick cleaning between baths, when a full wash is not practical.
products.image_alt: tuft + paw Pride and Groom The Mane Tame waterless shampoo bottle
products.notes: Chosen variant 'Default Title', USD 20.00, store SKU PG-MANE. Substitute for Burt's Bees Waterless Shampoo; burtsbees.com is Magento with no readable product feed from this host.
